description: This PHP source file defines the 'TimesheetCommentAPI' class, a REST API endpoint for handling operations related to timesheet comments within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It provides methods for updating and retrieving comments on timesheet entries, including validation, permission checks, and data serialization.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for updating and retrieving comments on timesheet entries, including validation, permission checks, and data serialization.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the comment for a specific timesheet entry. Validates input parameters, checks permissions, retrieves or creates a TimesheetItem, assigns the comment, and saves the changes.

methods.name: setCommentToTimesheetItem
methods.description: Sets the comment property of a TimesheetItem object based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update operation, including required parameters and constraints.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides additional validation rules for the request body, particularly for optional comment fields.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises not implemented exception.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific timesheet comment entry by its ID, after validating access rights.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific timesheet comment.

methods.name: checkAuthorityAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specified timesheet by its ID, throws exceptions if not found or unauthorized.
